name: dalton-company-wiki
description: Company and sector research wiki connector (read-only search, list, read, topic, and image retrieval).

dalton_company_wiki.description: Company & sector research wiki (search, read, list, topic; supports media='all'|'text'|'images' and UTC ISO indexed_since).
dalton_company_wiki.instruction: Read-only company & sector research wiki. Use `list(params={'company': 'TICKER'})` to browse documents, `search(query=..., params={'media': 'all'|'text'|'images', 'indexed_since': '...'})` to retrieve, `read(document='wiki:<id>')` to read full text with offset/max_chars paging, and `topic(query=...)` for tag lookup.
